leftEvidence.title: The eleven see Jesus, worship, and some doubt before the commission

points.label: Before direct speech
points.left: The eleven arrive at the appointed mountain, see, worship, and some doubt.
points.right: Mary and two travelers report appearances, but their hearers do not believe.

points.label: Jesus’ response
points.left: Jesus approaches and speaks of authority and commission.
points.right: Jesus appears at the table and rebukes unbelief and hardness of heart.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: Reports are disbelieved before Jesus appears and rebukes the eleven

payload.tension: The accounts name doubt or unbelief in different scenes and do not identify one shared psychological sequence.
payload.title: Unbelief rebuked / worship and doubt named
